mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2% for at least 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) from prior month indicate weakening consumer demand and housing market contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during early contraction phases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signals improving economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive (quarterly YoY).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 93.0 for two consecutive months indicates manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO remains below 93.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate above 9.0% and federal funds rate below 0.2% signal policy response to labor market weakness, predicting negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: policy response to labor market weakness
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) during housing market recovery (HOUST rising) signals robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rises and RSAFS rises.
